title: Sanitization Gateway and TTL Cohorting for Tenant-Sensitive Telemetry
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight Sanitization Gateway that sits in front of the observability pipeline (traces, logs, metrics metadata) to enforce tenant-aware redaction, cohort-based TTLs, and auditable pseudonymization. Goals: reduce PII exposure in downstream systems, enable per-tenant retention cohorts (short/standard/long), provide RBAC-backed just-in-time (JIT) reveal with a cryptographic audit ledger, and minimize latency added to ingest paths. The gateway must be schema-driven (open telemetry attributes + custom key-value rules), support streaming redact/transform operations, and be able to operate in both hosted and private deployments with the same enforcement semantics. This ticket covers the core gateway implementation, deterministic pseudonymization library, cohort assignment service, and a migration plan for existing observability stores.
acceptance_criteria: Sanitization Gateway deployed in canary with <10ms median added latency for trace ingest under 95th-percentile load (measured in staging)
Policy engine supports tenant-level TTLs and cohort assignment; cohorts: ephemeral-7d, standard-90d, archival-365d
Deterministic pseudonymizer produces stable, reversible tokens when JIT reveal permission exists; irreversible hashes when not
Audit ledger records every JIT reveal request with tenant, actor, reason, and token fingerprint; entries immutable and queryable by SRE/security
RBAC integration with console SSO (OIDC/SAML) mapping to allow JIT reveal for permitted roles
Integration tests for traces/logs/metrics demonstrating redaction rules and schema-driven exceptions (allowlist by attribute path)
Backfill tool proposal documented with cost estimate and CLI plan for safe migration of existing indices to cohort TTLs
tasks: Design policy language (YAML/JSON) for attribute-level redaction and cohort rules
Implement streaming sanitization pipeline using worker pool with per-tenant config cache
Build deterministic pseudonymization lib with KMS-wrapped seeds and rotation support
Add RBAC/JIT reveal service and tie to console audit events
Create benchmark harness and synthetic load tests (trace size distribution) for latency profiling
Draft migration/backfill plan and run cost simulation against current S3/ES retention curves
Open initial PR and solicit security review; address feedback
